personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK (with warm amber/rust command-center accents)
personality_one_liner: An uncompromising mobile command center for mission-critical AI servers and autonomous multi-agent export operations.

spacing.rule: Generous modular padding with compact high-density metric rows. Padding strictly follows 4-point baseline grid.

do's: Use crisp 1pt borders (#30363D) for operational cards
Ensure OLED-friendly contrast for system metrics
Use amber/rust accents strictly for active states and critical controls
dont's: No heavy blurs on dense data screens

screens.name: Dashboard Utama
screens.purpose: High-level command center showing server status, 7 AI workers, active target markets, recent activities, and quick actions.

states.loading: Centered dark spinner with pulsing amber telemetry indicator.
states.empty: No active telemetry feeds. Initialize backend connection.
states.error: Failed to poll server heartbeat. Retry connection button.

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with server online badge & drawer toggle. Overview metric cards (CPU, RAM, Uptime, Active AI). 7 AI status summary grid with quick ON/OFF toggles. Active target country chips. Recent activity stream with audit log indicators.

screens.name: Kontrol 7 AI
screens.purpose: Individual management and monitoring for the 7 autonomous export AI agents connected to the backend.

states.loading: Skeleton card rows with shimmer effect.
states.empty: No AI agents registered in backend registry.
states.error: Failed to fetch AI cluster state. Retry.

screens.layout: Vertical list of 7 AI agent cards (AI 1 to AI 7). Each card includes name, function, ON/OFF toggle, status badge (Working/Idle/Error), last activity timestamp, and interactive detail modal trigger.

screens.name: Pilih Negara
screens.purpose: Manage target export countries via server-synced checkboxes and bulk activation controls.

states.error: Failed to sync country whitelist from server.

screens.layout: Header with bulk action bar (Pilih Semua, Hapus Semua, Aktifkan Negara, Nonaktifkan Negara). Filterable country list with status toggles and region badges.

screens.name: Kontrol Server
screens.purpose: Monitor backend resource consumption, API status, and execute critical infrastructure commands.

states.error: API handshake timeout. Check secure token.

screens.layout: Server status banner (ONLINE/OFFLINE), IP/Domain display, API health badge, real-time gauges for CPU, RAM, and Storage. Action buttons for SERVER ON, SERVER OFF (with confirmation modal), and RESTART SERVER.

screens.name: Interogasi Server
screens.purpose: Comprehensive system diagnostics reporting connection status, database health, job execution stats, and audit logs.

states.loading: Running diagnostic handshake across all 7 AI nodes...
states.error: Interrogation aborted due to network failure.

screens.layout: Prominent 'CHECK SERVER' execution button. Diagnostic result cards categorized into OK / WARNING / ERROR with live log console output.

screens.name: Akses / User
screens.purpose: Role-based access control management for SUPER ADMIN, ADMIN, and KARYAWAN roles.

states.error: Failed to load access control list.

screens.layout: Role summary cards, user directory list with role badges, permission toggle matrix synced with server backend.

screens.name: Pengaturan
screens.purpose: Configure secure API endpoints, JWT tokens, notification thresholds, and audit logging preferences.

states.error: Failed to save configuration to backend.

screens.layout: Grouped settings sections: Server Endpoint Configuration, Security & JWT Tokens, Notification Triggers, and Audit Logging.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Export 7 AI Control Center using React Native and Expo Router following the 7 Dark-First Utility DARK personality. Ensure all 7 AI agents, server telemetry, country selector, server interrogation, and RBAC system are fully interactive with mock backend API integration. Implement secure token handling, confirmation modals for dangerous server actions, and a sliding drawer navigation menu.
